facts.text: Snow left Swan Lake Mtn (6,830 ft) 51 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Swan Lake Mtn
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 26 (2023), May 20 (2024), May 24 (2025)

facts.text: At Swan Lake Mtn (6,830 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 0.6 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Swan Lake Mtn
evidence.detail: 0.6 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 33.4 in (2023), 29.3 in (2024), 45.9 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between January 28 and April 7, carried from the melt-out date at Swan Lake Mtn (6,830 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Swan Lake Mtn
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 1,758 ft above the pass; points to January 28 to April 7
